<!-- markdownlint-disable-file MD041 -->
## Change and purpose

Describe what changes, why it is needed, and any compatibility impact.
Link related issues where applicable.

## Destination

Confirm the target branch using
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/devdocsorg/meta-qcom-3rdparty/blob/docs/layer-documentation/CONTRIBUTING.md).
Identify any dependent or upstream changes.

## Validation

Record the exact checks or commands performed and their results, including the
CI helper checks and any build or boot test. Explain anything not checked.

## Documentation and review

- [ ] I reviewed the change and updated affected documentation and folder indexes.
- [ ] Function comments, configuration documentation, and tutorials match the change.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; exceptions or unresolved dependencies are explained above.
- [ ] The change and its evidence contain no credentials or confidential data.

Mark inapplicable items with a reason. Use the private route in
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/devdocsorg/meta-qcom-3rdparty/blob/docs/layer-documentation/SECURITY.md)
for vulnerability details.
